Controls nobody tells you 6

Rockstar explains the big stuff. These are the buttons it leaves out. All for the Default control scheme; PS5 first, then Xbox.

  • 17 hidden controls, on one sheetKeep the engine running, hide from cops in your car, flip people off, feel the speed limit.Reported
    What it doesPS5Xbox
    Get out but keep the engine and lights running (a quicker getaway)Double-tap TriangleDouble-tap Y
    Get straight into the back seat instead of walking round to the passenger doorHold TriangleHold Y
    Hide from the police inside your parked carHold CircleHold B
    Rest: lean on a rail, sit on a dock, or just stand aroundHold Circle on footHold B on foot
    Look in first person while standing still (great for reading signs)Hold L2, press R3; R2 zoomsHold LT, press RS; RT zooms
    Flip someone offHold L2, press R1 (in a car: R1)Hold LT, press RB (in a car: RB)
    Yell at other driversR3 while drivingRS while driving
    Swing the car door into bikers and copsSquare while drivingX while driving
    Kick people from a bikeSquare while ridingX while riding
    Turn signalsTap Left / Right on the D-padTap Left / Right on the D-pad
    Radio on or off (also with earbuds on foot)Double-tap Left on the D-padDouble-tap Left on the D-pad
    Headlights on, off and full beamCircle while drivingB while driving
    Vehicle menu: windows, lights, drop a boat's anchorHold Left on the D-pad, right stick up to VehicleHold Left on the D-pad, right stick up to Vehicle
    Talk to people without leaving the carHold Up on the D-padHold Up on the D-pad
    Swap your aiming shoulderLeft on the D-pad while aimingLeft on the D-pad while aiming
    Partner commands: tell your partner to drive, or to follow youHold Right on the D-padHold Right on the D-pad
    Feel the speed limit in the triggerPull R2 to the first point of resistancePS5 only

    The speed-limit trick needs Adaptive Triggers Resistance switched on: Options › Settings › Controller › DualSense Wireless Controller Features. Using the Classic scheme? Some buttons move (see the guide below).

    Sources

    • Push Square: GTA 6: Secret Controls the Game Doesn't Tell You · 25 Nov 2026
    • PC Gamer: 15 hidden GTA 6 controls and features you should know about · 20 Nov 2026
  • Flip your car back over (or shove a boat off the beach)The old wiggle-the-stick trick is gone. You do it on foot.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Get out and walk into the side of the upturned car, as if pushing it with your body.
    2. Keep walking into it until Jason or Lucia switches to a pushing pose.
    3. Press Square (PS5) or X (Xbox) to shove it back onto its wheels.

    In a race

    You can't get out, so hold Touchpad (PS5) or View (Xbox) to reset onto the road facing the right way. Still ruined? Pause and pick Restart Event.

    Good to know

    • The same shove pushes a beached boat back into the water.
    • Flipping doesn't repair anything: fix it at a gas pump.
    • PC Gamer's list gives L3 for the shove. If Square / X does nothing on your control scheme, try that.

    Sources

    • VGC: How to flip a car in Grand Theft Auto 6 · 25 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: How to flip your car in GTA 6 · 22 Nov 2026
  • Make your partner drive a second getaway carTwo cars, one crew: your partner follows you in their own ride.Reported

    How to do it

    1. With your partner next to you, hold Right on the D-pad to open the command menu.
    2. Press Cross (PS5) / A (Xbox) to tell your partner to drive.
    3. Get into a different car yourself.
    4. Hold Right on the D-pad again and press Square / X: your partner now follows right behind you.

    Good to know

    • Handy for parking a second getaway car near a robbery, or to bring two cars home at once.

    Source

    • Push Square: GTA 6: Secret Controls the Game Doesn't Tell You · 25 Nov 2026
  • Let the car drive itself (Auto Drive)A cinematic cruise to any waypoint. It isn't fast travel: it waits in traffic.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Get in a vehicle and set a destination marker on the map.
    2. Hold Down on the D-pad for the camera options and, still holding it, press Options (PS5) / Menu (Xbox) to open the Cinematic menu.
    3. Hold the button shown next to Enable Auto Drive in the bottom right.
    4. Use the triggers to pick one of three speeds. The right stick moves the camera and R3 / RS changes the view. Move the map marker any time to reroute.

    Good to know

    • Your driver obeys the road rules and sits in traffic, so it is slow. It's made for screenshots, clips and sightseeing.
    • Other drivers can still crash into you.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: How to use auto drive in GTA 6 to cruise around Leonida · 23 Nov 2026
  • Get GTA V's controls backSprint on X / A again, the way your thumbs remember.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Press Options (PS5) / Menu (Xbox) and open Settings.
    2. Open Control Scheme and switch from Default to Classic.

    What moves

    Default: sprint is L3 / LS, jump is Cross / A, melee is Square / X.
    Classic: run is Cross / A, melee is Circle / B, jump and climb are Square / X.

    Good to know

    • The HUD hides itself by default. Press Down on the D-pad to show the minimap, money, health, stamina and Focus, or set them to stay on in Settings.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: How to get classic GTA 5 controls in GTA 6 · 18 Nov 2026
    • Push Square: the Control Scheme menu path · 25 Nov 2026
  • Make Jason and Lucia walk fasterOne setting, no extra button: a quicker everyday pace.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Open Settings › Gameplay and scroll to Movement.
    2. Set Movement Speed to Fast Walk, Jog or Run (Walk is the default).
    3. Optional: Combat Movement Speed sets your pace in a gunfight (Fast Walk, Jog or Run).

    Good to know

    • It changes your pace with the stick pushed all the way, not your sprint, so it costs no stamina.
    • Tilt the stick only a little and you still walk slowly.

    Source

    • PC Gamer: Try this GTA 6 movement speed setting to make Jason and Lucia walk faster · 20 Nov 2026

Getting around 5

Leonida is huge and cars break. How to skip the drive, keep your ride, and get into the good ones.

  • Fast travel: skip the drive for $100There's no teleport menu. Taxis, the RydeMe app and buses do the job.Reported

    Three ways

    1. Taxi. You get Paradise Taxi's number in Chapter 1. Press Up on the D-pad for your phone, open Contacts and call. It takes Pocket Cash. In the cab, focus on the driver with L2 / LT and pick skip with Triangle / Y: $100 extra and you're there.
    2. RydeMe app (from Chapter 2). Phone › RydeMe, then home to your safehouse or any destination. It charges your BuckMe account. Same $100 skip.
    3. Bus or train. Hold Down on the D-pad to see nearby stops, wait for the next one, set a destination on the route, then hold Triangle / Y to skip the journey.

    Good to know

    • Skipping a long ride also moves the clock forward.
    • Short of cash for the taxi? An ATM turns bank money into Pocket Cash.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: How to fast travel in GTA 6 · 19 Nov 2026, updated 23 Nov
  • Keep a car for good, and get it back when it's wreckedOnly registered cars come back. Everything else is gone for good, trunk and all.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Drive the car to a Pay 'n' Spray (Index › Vehicles) and choose Register. The fee depends on the car.
    2. Lost, destroyed or impounded? The ScooterBros app on your phone brings a registered car back for a fee, and it can deliver any registered car to you.
    3. Each of Jason and Lucia has one personal vehicle. Buy garages to register more.
    4. Not registered? Leave it in a parking space outside your safehouse or in a garage, or you may lose it.

    Good to know

    • Cars with a standard or advanced tracker can't be registered until later in the story.
    • Your personal vehicle's trunk holds stash bags, and you can change your loadout and outfit there.
    • Impounded with loot in the trunk? Check the Personal tab of the Index for the lot and steal it back yourself; the paid recovery can lose stash bags.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: GTA 6 Personal Vehicles explained · 19 Nov 2026
  • Repair your car at the gas pumpGas stations fix wrecks too, and most players drive straight past.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Pull up close to a pump (gas pump icons on the map) until Services appears.
    2. Choose Repair. The price depends on the damage, and the car comes back fixed.
    3. Low on fuel? Same menu, choose Refuel and hold the button shown until the tank is full.

    Good to know

    • A full tank lasts a long time. A car you've just stolen may be nearly empty, though.
    • Electric cars use charging stations: pull up and choose Charge Vehicle.

    Source

    • PC Gamer: Refueling cars in GTA 6 is barely necessary, but there's much better reason to visit garages · 19 Nov 2026
  • Steal keyless cars with the Key ClonerThe best cars have no key. From Chapter 3, your phone opens them.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Play to the Chapter 3 story mission where Randy asks you to steal the Zorrusso ("Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs"). Randy puts the Key Cloner app on your phone. There's no way to get it sooner.
    2. Before you steal, scan the car with the WAiNK app (Up on the D-pad). It tells you if the key needs cloning and what tracker the car has.
    3. At the driver's door press Triangle / Y (Clone Key) and turn the right stick until the meter turns pink, with a whir and a rumble. Hold it there until the meter fills.
    4. Get in: no alarm, no hotwiring.

    Watch the tracker

    • Standard tracker: no mods until you register the car at Randy's.
    • Advanced tracker: it tells the police where you are if you drive too slowly, so keep your speed up. You can't sell or keep these until you're further through Randy's Wish List.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: How to get a GTA 6 Key Cloner · 21 Nov 2026, updated 25 Nov
    • VICE: How to Clone Keys in GTA 6 and Unlock the Key Cloner · 20 Nov 2026
  • Shake the heat: respray, mask up, change clothesCops now remember your car and your outfit, not just your face.Reported

    Vehicle Heat

    1. Find a Pay 'n' Spray: Index › Vehicles › Pay 'n' Spray lists them, nearest first.
    2. Drive in and respray. That clears the car's heat. You can't get in while the police can see you (stars fully filled).
    3. No time? Dumping the car also clears Vehicle Heat, but the police will probably impound it.

    Appearance Heat

    1. Buy a mask at Chuck's Tackle & Shot in Key Lento (from the start of the game) or any Ammu-Nation.
    2. At your wardrobe, add it to your loadout (Accessories › Masks).
    3. Hold L1 / LB, press R1 / RB to the items, pick the neckwear slot at the top of the wheel and press Cross / A. Up and down on that slot changes how it's worn.
    4. Or change your outfit at your personal vehicle's trunk.

    Good to know

    • Robbed a store with cameras? Mask up to shed Appearance Heat.
    • One wear style covers your face and makes shop clerks panic; the other wears it down.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: How to respray cars in GTA 6 and shift your vehicle heat level · 19 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: How to get a mask in GTA 6 and disguise yourself from cops · 21 Nov 2026, updated 25 Nov
    • GamesRadar+: GTA 6 Personal Vehicles explained · 19 Nov 2026

Saves, time and things you can miss 5

No mission replays, a long day and night, and bonus items that vanish after a chapter.

  • Save by hand, and why it sometimes won't let you15 manual slots, a hidden 16th for the autosave, and no quit button.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Open the main menu (Options / Menu).
    2. Choose Game, then Save Game.
    3. Pick one of the 15 slots and save.

    Save greyed out?

    • You can't save during a mission. Restart from a checkpoint in the pause menu instead.
    • In free roam it can block you right after a phone call or objective: leave the building or vehicle and try again.
    • Cheats switch saving off until you reload.

    Good to know

    • There's no Quit option. Save, then close the game from the console's home screen.
    • The autosave misfired at launch and some players lost hours. Update 1.002.002 (23 Nov) fixed "an issue that resulted in the game not autosaving correctly". Save by hand anyway.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: How to save your game progress in GTA 6 · updated 23 Nov 2026
    • PC Gamer: Here's how to save your game in GTA 6 · 18 Nov 2026
    • Insider Gaming: Does GTA 6 Auto Save? · 19 Nov 2026
    • Eurogamer: the 23 Nov patch notes · 23 Nov 2026
  • Want to replay a mission? Plan your savesGTA VI has no mission replay. Your save slots are the replay.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Keep one manual save at the start of each chapter, and one at the end.
    2. Before a big story mission, save in a fresh slot.
    3. To play a mission again, load the save from just before it.

    Good to know

    • Rockstar dropped mission replay on purpose and made missions harder to fail instead.
    • 15 slots cover the whole story, so spend them on chapter starts and big missions.

    Sources

    • Eurogamer: You cannot replay missions in GTA 6, but you can use multiple save files · 18 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: How to save your game progress in GTA 6 · updated 23 Nov 2026
  • Skip to night (or morning)Some jobs only run at certain hours. Sleep, and you pick the hour you wake up.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Check the Index first for jobs with an hourglass: they're time-limited, and you can sleep through them.
    2. Go to a bed at one of your safehouses and lie down.
    3. Press Square / X to sleep and choose to wake in the morning, at noon, in the evening or at night.

    Good to know

    • Skipping a taxi ride and fixing up the house also move the clock.
    • Night changes things: police take a little longer to show up, especially far from the city.
    • After the story, two cheats move or pause time. They unlock by finding 10 and 20 collectible watches.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: How to skip and pass time in GTA 6 · 20 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: How to change the time of day in GTA 6 · 19 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: All GTA 6 cheats for PS5 and Xbox · 18 Nov 2026
  • Ultimate Edition: ride the Chapter 1 extras before they're goneSome bonus vehicles only work in Chapter 1.Reported

    How to do it

    1. In Chapter 1, use Jason's Dinka Enduro motorbike and Crest Kayak.
    2. Pick up the retro Vapid Ganado at Coastal Auto Care in Key Lento.
    3. All three only work during Chapter 1, so enjoy them before you move the story on.

    When the rest unlocks

    • The exclusive shops open in Chapter 1, and a lot more by the end of Chapter 2.
    • The Shitzu Squalo and the Vice City Style outfits come in Chapter 4, and the '95 Grotti Cheetah in Chapter 5. Eurogamer puts that at around 60 hours.

    Source

    • Eurogamer: Some of GTA 6's Ultimate Edition content is only available for the first chapter · 18 Nov 2026
  • Find the free pink "Porsche" (Vanessa's Growler)A free car locked behind a laptop password in Chapter 3.Reported

    How to do it

    1. In Chapter 3 you move into Vanessa's apartment in Vice City. She left her laptop behind.
    2. Work out the laptop password and read the message about something waiting for her in La Perle, next to Auntie's Place.
    3. Open that lock-up with the door code 92665. The baby-pink Pfister Growler is free to keep.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: Don't miss out on getting Vanessa's Pink Porsche Growler in GTA 6 · 24 Nov 2026

Settings and fixes 4

The picture, the difficulty, a crash, and the clips your Xbox shares without asking.

  • Game too dark? Fix the HDR settingsThe in-game check can mislead you. Here are starting values that work.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Go to Options › Settings › Display › HDR Calibration.
    2. Ignore whether the Rockstar logo is "just visible". Judge by the two pictures of the boat party instead; R1 switches between the light and dark one.
    3. Start from Brightness 2,000, Black Levels 20, Paper White 35 (for a TV that reaches 1,000 nits or more).
    4. Adjust from there for your TV and your room.

    Good to know

    • The game ignores the PS5's own system HDR calibration, so tuning that won't help here.
    • The values come from HDTV Test's measurements on a reference monitor.

    Source

    • Push Square: GTA 6: Why Is It Too Dark? Here's How to Fix HDR Settings · 20 Nov 2026
  • Make it easier without cheatsNo difficulty slider, but two switches do the same job.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Open Settings › Gameplay.
    2. Turn on Accessible Combat: enemies have less health and do less damage to you.
    3. Turn on Reduced Vehicle Damage: your ride takes less from gunfire, crashes and the world.

    Good to know

    • Rockstar warns that these "significantly change the balance and experience" of the game.
    • Cheats are no help mid-story: they only work after the ending, and they switch off saving.

    Source

    • Eurogamer: Does GTA 6 have an 'easy mode'? · 19 Nov 2026
  • PS5 keeps crashing (error CE-108255-1)No named fix yet. These are the steps to try, in order.Reported

    Try these

    1. Install the latest update first (1.002.002 fixed "several issues that caused the game to crash").
    2. Make sure the game fully installed: highlight GTA VI, press Options and check Download Status.
    3. Restore your licences: Settings › Users and Accounts › Other › Restore Licenses.
    4. Clear the cache and rebuild the database from the PS5's Safe Mode.
    5. Delete and reinstall. If it's on an external drive, move it to internal storage.

    Good to know

    • Players report it after about 40 minutes of play, or at fixed moments (in the opening, or the plunger in Pipework).
    • As of 23 Nov, Rockstar hasn't named this error code as fixed.

    Sources

    • Eurogamer: GTA 6 keeps crashing on some PS5s with error CE-108255-1 · 21 Nov 2026
    • Eurogamer: the 23 Nov patch notes · 23 Nov 2026
  • Stop your Xbox uploading your GTA clipsClips upload by default, and some GTA scenes can break Xbox's content rules.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Press the Xbox button.
    2. Go to Profile & system › Settings › Preferences › Capture & share.
    3. Under Automatic uploads, choose Xbox network and set it to Don't upload.
    4. Do the same for OneDrive if you don't want anything uploaded.

    Why

    • Xbox's Community Standards ban mature sexual content in shared clips and screenshots. A GTA clip can cross that line without you noticing.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: How to turn off GTA 6 auto uploads on Xbox · 21 Nov 2026

Money and heists 4

Where your money lives, how you lose it, and the two big scores the game never explains.

  • Where your money lives, and how you lose itPocket cash disappears when you're Wasted or Busted. Savings can never come back out.Reported

    The three pots

    1. Pocket Cash. Real bills. Jason and Lucia can each carry up to $20,000. You lose all of it if you're Wasted or Busted, so put big sums in the bank at an ATM.
    2. BuckMe Checking. The bank app on your phone (Up on the D-pad). Shops take cash up to $1,000; anything bigger comes from here. The account limit rises in Chapters 2, 3 and 4. At the limit, new payments sit pending until there's room.
    3. BuckMe Family Savings. Shared by both of them, with five goals and growing interest. Money paid in can never be taken back out.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: How to manage money in GTA 6 and use BuckMe bank · 19 Nov 2026
  • Rip an ATM out of the wallWait for the dye pack jammer, or the cash blows up pink.Reported

    Before you start

    • The Dye Pack Jammer comes from the Chapter 3 story mission Credit Check. Without it the cash explodes.
    • A winch: fit one to a pickup or off-roader at a mod shop. PC Gamer also names ready-made winch trucks at the crop duster strip in Frogswater and behind Yasmani's vape shop in Little Cuba.

    How to do it

    1. In a winched vehicle, ATMs you can tow show on the map. Only wall-mounted outdoor ones work.
    2. Reverse up to it until it hooks on ("Unhook" appears bottom right).
    3. Floor it to tear the ATM out, then get away from the alarm and the police first.
    4. Somewhere quiet, swerve hard so the cash canisters break loose. Unhook with Right on the D-pad.
    5. Get out and smash each canister (melee), grab the marked bills, and take them to a fence.

    Good to know

    • Finish Yasmani's three jewelry jobs and he tips you off to three full ATMs, but you only get one in-game day.
    • PC Gamer got about $11,000 per tipped ATM.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: How to steal GTA 6 ATMs and get away with it · 26 Nov 2026
    • PC Gamer: How to get a winched vehicle to steal ATM machines in GTA 6 · 25 Nov 2026
    Yasmani on the map
  • Open a bank vault (you can't; the guard can)Vault doors won't budge. Follow the armored car guard in, and he opens it for you.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Find an armored car. Either finish all of Yasmani's jobs until, in Chapter 4, he sells you a $10,000 tip (two vans appear as pink icons), or watch the streets near the big banks.
    2. Banks with vaults are on the map under Robberies › Big Bank Jobs: four in Ocean Beach, two Downtown, one in Tequesta, one at the airport.
    3. Follow the van to the bank and let the guard walk deep inside. He goes to the vault and opens it.
    4. Now start the robbery. Get to the back (explosives, or a door your snap gun opens), subdue the guard and take the cash cart.

    Extra loot

    • Safe deposit boxes: use Focus to see which ones open, then shoot them (or one grenade opens the lot).
    • The tills out front and office safes (with a safe code).
    • The van itself: stick a bomb on its back door so it can't despawn while you're inside, and blow it on your way out.

    Good to know

    • Bring your partner: there's enough for four bags, and one of you keeps the crowd down.
    • Use silenced guns. Big banks keep their camera footage in the cloud, so shoot the cameras.
    • An alarm means four stars at once. Park the getaway car where you can reach it.

    Source

    • PC Gamer: GTA 6 vault: How to open them during big bank jobs · 25 Nov 2026
  • How cheats actually work in GTA VIOnly after the ending, one challenge per code, and no saves or trophies while on.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Finish the main story. Until then no code works, even if you know it.
    2. Open the main menu, press R1 / RB to the Progress tab and find the new Cheats page. Each of the 61 cheats has its own unlock condition, mostly challenges.
    3. In free roam, take out your phone (Up on the D-pad), hold L1 + R1 / LB + RB, and enter the code on the D-pad.

    Example, the $250,000 cheat (unlocked by finishing the story): Up Right Down Left Up Left Down Right

    The catch

    • Once a cheat is on, trophies and achievements are off for that session, and so is saving. Reload a save to get them back.

    Sources

    • GamesRadar+: All GTA 6 cheats for PS5 and Xbox · 18 Nov 2026
    • Eurogamer: on cheats locking saves and progress · 19 Nov 2026

Life in Leonida 5

Music on foot, the secret playlists, the relationship meter, pets, and getting fitter.

  • Listen to the radio on footBuy earbuds once and the radio and podcasts follow you everywhere.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Find an electronics store: Index › Style › Electronics, nearest first (headphone icon). PC Gamer points to Zeke's Gadgets, about $150.
    2. Walk up to the earbud case and buy a pair.
    3. Put them in: hold L1 / LB, press R1 / RB to the items, pick them with the right stick, press Cross / A.
    4. Hold Left on the D-pad for the stations. Double-tap Left to switch the music on or off.

    Good to know

    • Podcasts: hold Left on the D-pad and push the right stick down. Pause one there and it picks up where you left off, on foot or in a car.
    • A fight can knock your earbuds out. Pick them up afterwards or they're gone.

    Sources

    • Kotaku: Here's How To Listen To The Radio On Foot In GTA 6 Using Headphones · 24 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: How to change radio stations and listen to podcasts in GTA 6 · 19 Nov 2026
    • PC Gamer: 15 hidden GTA 6 controls and features · 20 Nov 2026
  • Unlock the two secret playlistsScan posters with the WAiNK app: Kodak Black's mixtape and The Vault Radio.Reported

    The Sniper of La Perle (hosted by Kodak Black)

    Scan all four posters in La Perle and Crosstown. Your phone pings when one is close.

    1. TWA Ponya Tattoo: on the small table to the right of the door.
    2. Drip Drops: lying on the cash register counter.
    3. Aunt Zola's Soul Food: on the corkboard just left of the entrance, by the register.
    4. Jack of Hearts (from Chapter 3): upstairs in the recording studio's control room, on the table by a fan.

    The Vault Radio

    One poster at The Vault nightclub: down the entrance corridor, on the back wall (a gas mask on red).

    Good to know

    • Both count toward 100% completion.
    • Their songs play nowhere else in the game.

    Sources

    • PC Gamer: GTA 6 has secret radio stations you can unlock by scanning posters · 21 Nov 2026
    • Kotaku: GTA 6 Has Two Secret Music Playlists, Here's How To Find Them · 23 Nov 2026
    La Perle on the mapThe Vault on the map
  • Raise Jason and Lucia's relationshipFour levels, a heart for every kind act, and you have to play both of them.Reported

    The levels

    Running on Empty, Partners in Crime, Crazy in Love, Hot Together. A chime and a +♥ on the right of the screen tell you it went up.

    What raises it

    • Holding hands, greeting your partner, starting a conversation.
    • A hug or a kiss (the prompt with a heart).
    • Buying food or drinks and handing them over.
    • Going to bed at the same time, hanging out on the couch.

    What lowers it

    • Failing a joint mission, ignoring your partner for a while, some mission choices they disagree with, and hitting them with your car.

    Good to know

    • Rockstar says a strong relationship takes both sides: play as Lucia and treat Jason well too.

    Sources

    • PC Gamer: How Jason and Lucia's relationship actually works · 18 Nov 2026
    • GamesRadar+: How to change your relationship status · 18 Nov 2026
  • Pet the dogs (and cats)There's no prompt on screen. Praise them first, and the pet option appears.Reported

    How to do it

    1. Walk up to a dog or cat and press L2 / LT to focus on it.
    2. Choose Praise a few times.
    3. The Pet option appears (it doesn't always work first time).

    Good to know

    • Study in the same menu is the only way to add an animal to your collection.
    • Only tame animals. There is one alligator you can pet, at the yard sale round the corner from Jason's house.

    Source

    • GamesRadar+: How do you pet animals in GTA 6? · 19 Nov 2026
  • Raise your strength and staminaWorkouts hit a daily wall; protein halves the wait. One odd side quest adds max stamina.Reported

    Workouts

    1. Strength: the deck behind Jason's house has the gear. Hold both triggers to lift, ease them off to lower, and watch your stamina bar.
    2. Cardio: hang the punching bag (behind the workshop under the house) and hit it with melee, or just run and swim for a while.
    3. When you hit the wall for the day, rest. Protein afterwards halves the wait. The Fitness app on your phone shows where you stand.

    The Final Flush (max stamina)

    1. In the men's toilet at the north tip of Corsair Key (north-east of Key Lento), scan the #NOFLUSHERS QR poster with WAiNK and reply "Truth".
    2. Meet the stranger at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta. He seems to show up only at night.
